entities.summary: Sir Andrew Hopper is a British-Polish computer technologist and entrepreneur. He is a Founding Partner at Cambridge AI Venture Partners and since 2025 has been Chairman of CommonAI Community Interest Company and CommonAI Compute Ltd. He is also Commissioner of the Royal Commission for the Exhibition of 1851, former Treasurer and Vice-President of the Royal Society, Professor Emeritus of Computer Technology at the University of Cambridge, an Honorary Fellow of Trinity Hall, Cambridge and Corpus Christi College, Cambridge.
